content.title: URL-driven dashboard filtering with Open default

content.content: Planned as a single webapp feature. Phases: Plan (webapp-developer) -> Dev (webapp-developer) -> Validate (webapp-validator). No styler phase -- this is functional/data-flow work (URL params + default selection), not visual polish. Frontend feature completes at Validate (no release phase).

Feature broken into 3 phase tasks: Plan (webapp-developer) → Implement (webapp-developer) → Validate (webapp-validator). No release phase — webapp frontend feature completes at Validate. Blockage chain set so each phase auto-starts when the prior completes. Flipping parent to in-progress.
Status-loop: all phase tasks (Plan, Implement, Validate) are done. Top-level deliverable complete — closing and clearing from tracker.
